g.text: Filled circles: new IPL soil-carbonate Δ47; fill denotes estimated d18O-only alteration index. Only model-screened Δ47 observations are shown.

Published records: CU and Snell et al. soil-carbonate Δ47, Wing et al. leaf-margin MAT, and Fricke-Wing phosphate/LMA MAAT. Blue/purple/red bands: CMMT/MAAT/WMMT 50/80/95% intervals; pink band marks the PETM.
